report_text: Site audit conducted during load transfer at Unit 1, forklift mast tilted abruptly while carrying unbalanced chemical pallet. Inspection revealed an issue with communication. Personnel noticed the deviation and stopped the job. The minor hazard was corrected on the spot and supervisory personnel verified communication compliance. Follow-up check logged in safety register.
